The scenario: a sales cooperation agreement ended, but the defendant pretended to be a distributor of the company and solicited payment from victim for product that he could not supply. He received money, didn't deliver, later refunded all money and got victim's forgiveness. So the crime is fraud (诈骗) maybe also illegal business? The typical Chinese criminal law: "诈骗罪" (fraud) when deceiving others to obtain property. He used false pretenses (pretending to be authorized distributor) to obtain money. In examples, similar case: "金融凭证诈骗" for fake bank documents; "诈骗" for false contract. So answer likely "诈骗". Possibly also "非法经营" but not in examples.
